question: At fixed truth q_a, does the local-window surrogate-MSE over an omega-grid rank the truth-omega at the top?
hypothesis: With q_a pinned to truth, the local-window surrogate-MSE cost surface is sharply discriminative and ranks truth-omega at or near rank 1.
narrative_md: Cost-surface validator: at fixed truth q_a (T_A=25, seed 28), local-window surrogate-MSE over a Fibonacci 200-dir x 6-mag (+-30%) grid ranks truth-omega at rank 1/1407 (rho_local 0.389 = noise floor; runner-up 3.44 Band B). The omega-grid premise holds at zero q_a noise. Open: degradation at realistic cloud quantization (~7-10deg q_a). Pins q_a to truth and inserts truth-omega at grid idx 0 -- oracle-leak, N=1.
